name: Itazura Mahjong
source:
Katsuhiko is a white-collar worker and enjoys train molestation every day. One day, when he is on the train, he falls asleep and forgets to get off at his station. "This is the end of the line...." He wakes up and gets off.... There is, however, no wicket. He looks around and finds a gate. When he goes inside, there is a house with a sign "Mahjong Parlor".... As if led by an unknown power, he enters it....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090108002627/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011764]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
Katsuhiko是一名公司职员，每天都以在电车上猥亵他人为乐。一天，他在车上睡着，错过了下车的车站。“这里是终点站…”他醒来后走下列车…然而那里却没有检票口。他环顾四周，发现了一扇大门。走进去后，眼前是一栋挂着“麻将馆”招牌的房子…仿佛受到某种未知力量的引导，他迈步进入其中…

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090108002627/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011764]ErogeShop[/url]]
